verdict.rationale: n8n is positioned around a visual canvas for building workflows, and that is corroborated hands-on: a manager with zero programming skills built a complex scheduled and webhook-driven backend (n8n-comm-18), and users call it great for less-technical users (n8n-comm-6, n8n-comm-11). Other users report that non-programmers hit data-transformation errors and may need SQL or JSON parsing (n8n-comm-3, n8n-comm-13); this is a caveat on the no-code claim, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the visual editor itself, and evidence that typical data transformations can be done without code.
